name: Get Random Point in Navigable Radius
description: Finds a random point in navigable space restricted to a radius around an origin. Useful for AI wandering, patrol, and spawn placement on the navmesh. Target is Navigation System V1.

inputs.name: Origin
inputs.description: Center of the search area in world space. Connect a Get Actor Location, a Vector variable, or any world-space Vector.

inputs.name: Radius
inputs.description: Search radius around the origin in Unreal units (cm). Larger radii may return no result if no navmesh exists in that range.

inputs.name: Nav Data
inputs.description: Specific navigation data to query. Leave null (default) to use the active navigation system.

inputs.name: Filter Class
inputs.description: Optional filter class to constrain which nav areas are valid (for example to exclude water or lava).

outputs.name: Random Location
outputs.description: The sampled world-space location on the navmesh. Connect to Set Actor Location, AI MoveTo, or any node accepting a Vector.

outputs.name: Return Value
outputs.description: True if a valid point was found within the radius. Always check this before using the Random Location.
